title: RWB-S7-E6022-APP: the Finance feed slice provides no operation while four consumed surfaces and one external feed have no plan row, no column carries the feed result, and the feed transport, layouts and codes are unpublished
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6022-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-022; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.10.1 to A2.10.4.4, A1.3, A1.4 and Requirements served; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0 to T3.3, T4, T5.1 to T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T7, T-A and T-B; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-03 and R-WO-25 to R-WO-29; Event and Messaging Design v4 rows EV-24 and EV-26; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-10
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6022-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case state and move, the rwb-case reference-data answer of the tax criteria version, the rwb-decision package in force and calls the Finance provision feed, so one external call and four consumed surfaces have no plan row. (2) TSD S7 appendix T-A publishes two operations only, the scan (right C) and the committee decision (right A), and the legacy endpoint rows are those two, so the step provides no operation although the legacy story lists them under its own Endpoints. (3) No column of write_off carries the feed status, the feed reference, the acceptance code or the tax file reference in TSD S7 T3.1, so the record and the case state carry them and the story adds no column. (4) The transport, address, layouts, acceptance and rejection codes and retry limit of the Finance provision feed are named by no source in the read set, and Architecture v5 slide 13 gives rwb-writeoff no call to rwb-integration and no file cell while R-WO-26 names the Finance provision feed. (5) The operation names of the case read, the case-move answer and the reference-data read are published by no source. (6) TSD S7 T3.2 declares no list of values for the module. (7) The legacy Data table names document and decision_log_entry, which this service may not touch, and the legacy screen table gives SCR-27 no feed state, so no screen is invented. (8) The split plan carries no requirement id for the slice. (9) R-WO-26 and R-WO-27 name Credit Administration in their owner column while TSD S7 T6.1 gives RW-CREDITAD CRUA and the feature's primary use is 'None; runs unattended'.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S7-E6022-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03, DP-07, DP-13, DP-16 and DP-19 rows and R5.7 Day-1 rule; context pack service row (schema rwb_writeoff, base /api/recovery/writeoff/v1, topic rwb.writeoff.events.v1, queue rwb-writeoff, wave 4), ownership rows (write_off, 2 REST operations, event EV-24, job JOB-16, workflow WriteOffWorkflow) and connection-matrix row S7 (Temporal to P7, events to P8 and P1, REST and events to P1, no P2 and no file cell); TSD S7 T3.1 DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020, T3.2 with no list rows, T4 WRITEOFF machine, T5.1 no external interface, T5.3 WriteOffApproved, T6.1 right matrix, T-A.1 two operations and T-A.2 error lists; FSD S7 A2.10.2 integration points ALS and GL, A2.10.3.1 VR-S7-010-1 and R-WO-26, A2.10.3.3 roles; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-25 to R-WO-29; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-24 and EV-26; legacy RWB-E6-022 Data, Endpoints, Screen and states, Permission checks, Validation and messages, Acceptance criteria and Guardrails
area: Dependency, data, contract surface and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand and record the four reads and the feed call as class C in fact with their placeholders; declare no provided operation and name API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 as the scan's and the committee decision's; carry the feed status, the feed reference, the acceptance code and the tax file reference in the decision record and the case state and add no column, so the DB story keeps the schema; read the tax criteria version as reference data with its version and hold the case with MSG-S7-001 when none is in force; hold the month-end close as a durable timer of WriteOffWorkflow and declare no Schedule; adopt REQ-S7-005 for traceability with the note that the plan carries no requirement id; run the feed and the re-send under the service identity and let the Finance and CFO delegate and the Credit Administration officer read the outcome and work the R-WO-27 task

title: RWB-S7-E6022-CON: the contract baseline declares no operation and no answer property because TSD S7 T-A publishes no feed surface and no column carries the result, while the feed values, the operation names and the module's list of values are unpublished
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6022-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-022; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.10.2 and A2.10.3; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.3, T6.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-03 and R-WO-25 to R-WO-29; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-24 and EV-26; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-10
section: Metadata (Dependencies, Wave); Sections 2, 3, 7 AC1 to AC7, 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.5, 12.6, 12.8, 12.9 and 18
description: (1) TSD S7 appendix T-A publishes two operations, the scan (right C) and the committee decision (right A), and neither is a Finance feed or feed-result operation, so the baseline declares no provided operation and the two legacy endpoint rows are those two sibling stories'. (2) No column of write_off carries the feed status, the feed reference, the acceptance code or the tax file reference, so no published answer can carry the elements and they are declared as activity and record elements only. (3) The operation names of the case read, the case-move answer and the reference-data read, and the feed identifier, transport, address, layouts, acceptance codes and retry limit, are published by no source in the read set. (4) No source enumerates the feed item types, so the two names are baseline names. (5) TSD S7 T3.2 declares no list of values for the module, so the baseline declares none and records the absence. (6) The rejection message of the feed is Finance's row and no source gives it. (7) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice, and its C, I and X rows are empty while the baseline declares five consumed rows. (8) The plan's pattern set carries DP-03, DP-13 and DP-19 only, while the tax criteria version is reference data behind DP-07 and the feed is external behind DP-16.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 with rights C and A, and T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503; TSD S7 T3.1 field list with no feed column; TSD S7 T3.2 with a header and no list row; TSD S7 T4 WRITEOFF machine rows R-WO-25 to R-WO-29; TSD S7 T5.1 no external system interface and T5.3 WriteOffApproved; context pack service row (schema, base, topic, queue), ownership rows (write_off, 2 REST operations, event EV-24, job JOB-16, workflow WriteOffWorkflow) and connection-matrix row S7 (no P2 cell and no file cell); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-03 and R-WO-25 to R-WO-29; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-24 and EV-26; FSD S7 A2.10.2 integration points ALS and GL and A2.10.3.1 VR-S7-010-1, R-WO-26 and BR-S7-010; legacy RWB-E6-022 Endpoints, Data, Screen and states and Validation and messages
area: Contract surface, interface names and data
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders and the two absence records, confirm the three operation names and the feed values with their owners before the tag, keep the two item-type names as baseline names until the Finance feed row is published, declare no list of values and record the absence, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, and record the tag date in the contract README
